definition.label: Connect physical pieces
definition.description: One connection component for fixed joins and rotating hinges. Configure saved local frames without moving; attach creates a fixed join at the two CURRENT poses while physics is paused; align explicitly moves the owner to its connected frame (angle must be zero for fixed joins). Owner needs solid/bouncy physics; the other member may be fixed. Zero breakForce/breakTorque means unbreakable; positive limits are newtons/newton-metres. A PhysX break releases the body, emits object.connection.broken and stays broken through pause/resume. Rearm requires the exact members already aligned and clears only the live break latch; it does not save, teleport or add Undo. Configure/attach/align save once with one live-pose Undo and explicitly reset break state after successful persistence. Remove releases the component. Failed edits leave the original poses/connection. Connected-body collisions are suppressed; other collisions remain. Missing, misaligned or animation-owned members freeze the owner. Sixteen total connections, one outgoing link per creation, no cycles. Frames use +X as hinge axis and +Y as zero direction. Scaling/teleporting can require repair. Break state is runtime play state, not a saved damage field: workspace reload reconstructs the saved definition and still requires alignment. No automatic socket search, welding mesh merge or guessed identity. Temporary saved edits stay in their fork.
